title: Cross-Source Map Benchmark for GNSS-Denied UAV Localization
description: Reproducible cross-source (Google vs. Bing) map-matching benchmark and analysis code accompanying the article 'Cross-Autoencoder Structural Representations for GNSS-Denied UAV Localization by Template Matching: Flight Evaluation and a Large-Scale Cross-Source Map Benchmark' (submitted to Drones). Includes spatially blocked query sampling with fixed seeds, the deterministic hard_v1 photometric degradation profile, coarse-to-fine NCC matching, checkpoint screening with SHA-256 cataloguing, epoch sweep tooling and spatial block-bootstrap confidence intervals.
